inputs.prompt: Same Claude as <Picture 1>: orange hair, amber eyes, ivory lace veil, orange flower, white dress with orange embroidery and black ribbon, correct gentle adult anime face. Keep the exact upright body posture, lowered shoulders, gently bent elbows and wrists held by short chains under the wooden crossbeam. Her back remains against the central post, her body weight supported by her feet on a hidden ledge. Detailed Japanese gothic 2D anime with fine linework, layered cel shading and painted cathedral architecture. Cool blue stained glass and warm amber candle rim light, preserving copper-orange hair. No 3D doll look, no exaggerated grimace, no distorted joints, no captions, no cuts. Pull the framing back to a medium-wide view of the ritual cross at the TOP of the cathedral altar stairs. Claude is centered and visible from head to waist. A low stack of solid dry wooden logs surrounds her lower legs, reaching just BELOW her hips, never covering her chest. Two hooded acolytes in black robes with fine gold embroidery flank the pile in the foreground, faces obscured. The left acolyte slowly lowers one log onto the near left edge, releases the log, then withdraws both hands; the right acolyte holds still. No floating wood. Claude looks worriedly down toward someone below the steps, breathing softly without speaking or leaning forward. Crossbeam and body remain stable and vertical. The wood pile stays unlit. No fire, no smoke near Claude. Camera locked and level.
